_drive_supervision_source: Synthetic 1:1 simulation. Timeouts and disarm bound mirror a Rosie 1430 arm's machine configuration (previous values from the brake_opening_guard timeout and a Rosie 1430 arm's limits.following_error). Unverified, issue #158.
drive_speed_limit_motor_rpm_source: Owner decision 2026-09-15: A6M rated speed 3000 rpm, spec sheet and A6M60-400H2B1-M17 / A6M80-1000H2B1-M17 part numbers. One motor revolution is 131072 counts in the drive frame regardless of the electronic gear ratio, so a motor speed cap does not scale with the gear: 0x607F counts/s = drive_speed_limit_motor_rpm / 60 * motor_encoder_counts_per_rev. Independent of the inhibited start-up verification speed bound and software limits.max_velocity.

limits.max_source: cited: config/machines/bench/rosie1420-six-motors.json axes[0].limits min, max, max_velocity and jog_acceleration (owner 2026-09-21: the local simulation matches the machine; joints 1 to 6 take the Rosie 1420 bench limits); max_target_lead, following_error and the completion bounds stay the simulator's own tracking tolerances
limits.max_velocity_source: owner decision 2026-09-21: the 3000 rpm drive cap (drive_speed_limit_motor_rpm) through this joint's gear ratio, 314.159265 / ratio rad/s (18000 / ratio deg/s), equal to the URDF velocity rating (P8-44); the simulation matches the machine (J1 to J6 the Rosie 1420, J7 to J9 the Rosie 1400 positioner axes at 100:1); supersedes the v4 0.2 rad/s profile velocity
